column1: # The model families the ratchet knows (tools/model_tax.py, tools/check-model-tax.sh).
# family <TAB> token <TAB> extra own paths <TAB> since
#   token       a Python regex, matched case-insensitively against a code line and against a path (`(?-i:...)` turns
#               the folding off inside: `gemma` alone would match `GemmArgs`). A path that matches is the family's
#               own: its code may name its model.
#   extra paths comma-separated directory prefixes that are also the family's own (`-` none).
#   since       `baseline` for a family whose common-code names are the baseline debt (tools/model-tax.tsv `baseline`
#               rows), else the date the family joined: its rows are PIN rows only. A model announced before it has
#               code (kolibri, lfm, lightning) joins on the day its row is written.
# A family `-` is not a model: its token names a crate (gpu-<x>) that looks like a model directory and is common code.
# A new model starts with its row here. A directory crates/*/src/arch/<d>/, crates/gpu-<x>/ or tools/ref/models/<m>.sh
# that no row names fails the check ("unknown model dir").
